events.text: A village mistakes you for a hero from a storybook and throws you a feast.

choices.text: Eat and confess at the end

effects.log: They are disappointed. They let you keep the leftovers.
They want a dragon slain next. You leave at night.

events.text: A merchant's parrot has learned to insult passers-by.

effects.log: You lose. The parrot is better.
It learns "idiot" instead.

events.text: You drop your sword in front of a crowd during a demonstration.

choices.text: Bow as if it was part of the act

effects.log: They applaud. Some are not sure.
The crowd laughs with you.

events.text: Two roosters fight in the market. A crowd forms.

effects.log: Both attack you.

choices.text: Buy both and send them to separate farms

effects.log: Peace. (−2 taels)

events.text: You talk in your sleep at an inn. The whole dormitory hears your secret technique names.

effects.log: They were mostly nonsense.
Mystery preserved.

events.text: A dumpling-eating contest. The champion is a small old man.

ok.log: You beat him by one dumpling. He demands a rematch.

fail.log: He eats forty. You eat twelve. Respect.

choices.text: Cheer for the old man in your heart

effects.log: He wins. You feel smart.

events.text: You get lost in a big city and walk in circles for hours.

effects.log: You were next door the whole time.
You see the way, and the constables see you.

events.text: A village goat race. One goat is running backwards.

effects.log: It wins. Nobody knows how.
An hour of chaos.

events.text: You try to disguise yourself to avoid a boring party. Everyone recognises you.

effects.log: Everyone plays along. It becomes the best party.
They are disappointed.

events.text: You bow deeply to an elder and your trousers split.

effects.log: The elder bows back to save your dignity.
The elder laughs for a week.

events.text: You drink the wrong cup at a banquet. It was the host's special medicine.

effects.log: He laughs. The medicine was for his hair.
He gives you a jar of it.

events.text: Someone at the inn snores like thunder. Nobody can sleep.

effects.log: Blissful silence.
A duel of snores. You lose.

events.text: A flock of ducks blocks the road and refuses to move.

effects.log: An hour later they move. All together. Very dignified.
You are now a duck herder for an afternoon.

events.text: A child wears a cooking pot as a helmet and challenges you.

effects.log: The child is a hero for a day.
The kitchen war of the century.

events.text: You are mistaken for a ghost walking home late in white robes.

effects.log: The story is told for years.
They do not believe you.
